name: GPAL Golden Multi-Turn Evaluation Suite
description: Evaluates GPAL across voice preference switching, Google Search grounding delegation, and PII-redacted personal milestone storage.

eval_cases.description: User requests switching the companion voice to Aoede across sessions.

parts.text: Hey GPAL, can you switch your voice to Aoede so you sound breezy and cheerful in our future chats?
I've switched my voice to Aoede and saved that preference for all of our future conversations!

eval_cases.description: User asks a verifiable factual question that must be delegated to fact_checker_search_agent.

parts.text: What mission did NASA launch to study Jupiter's icy moon Europa, and when did it launch?

args.request: NASA mission to study Jupiter's moon Europa and launch date

parts.text: NASA launched the Europa Clipper mission in October 2024 to conduct detailed reconnaissance of Jupiter's icy moon Europa!

eval_cases.description: User shares a personal milestone alongside raw PII; GPAL scrubs PII and stores the sanitized note.

parts.text: I just registered for my first half-marathon in October! My confirmation email went to runner.alex@example.com and my phone is 415-555-0199.

args.memory_note: Registered for first half-marathon in October

parts.text: Congratulations on signing up for your first half-marathon in October! I've saved that milestone so we can track your training together.
